audit.whatIsWrong: The shipped chart hands Neeko level 1 and Singed level 3; the entry's own whys say the reverse, and diff reads TRICKY 7.5/10 against a 53.17% Emerald+ rate over 568 games.
audit.why: whys[0] 'Poison Trail ticks for free every time she steps toward CS', whys[1] 'she cannot casually walk up behind you', whys[2] 'a genuine skill-shot check'. The audit packet levelChart (Singed / Singed / Skill / Singed / Neeko / Singed / Singed) matches that prose exactly.
audit.corrected: Levels 1-2 Singed: her damage needs Blooming Burst to land and she has no answer to Fling yet. Level 3 even once Tangle-Barbs is up. Levels 4-5 Singed on the proxy. Level 6 Neeko on Pop Blossom. First item onward Singed. Overall EVEN, 5.5/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every spike is described without a cooldown, and Pop Blossom's spike is mis-described: spikes[1] calls the ult's wind-up a long channel.
audit.why: Riot's text says 'After a short preparation, Neeko leaps into the air' and, decisively, 'The preparation is hidden if Neeko is disguised.' A player told the channel is long will stand still waiting for a tell that a disguised Neeko never shows. Cooldowns: Pop Blossom 120/105/90s, Tangle-Barbs 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s, Blooming Burst 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s, Shapesplitter 16s to 12s.
audit.corrected: Neeko spikes: level 3 Tangle-Barbs, level 6 Pop Blossom (120/105/90s). Yours: level 3 Mega Adhesive plus Fling, level 6 Insanity Potion (100s), then Rylai's. Her ult preparation is short and invisible while she is disguised — never treat a wind-up you cannot see as a reaction window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three claims are wrong or missing. content.early says 'Neeko is melee-range dependent for real damage'; content.mid and whys[0] say she has 'no dash or chase tool'; whys[3] says Tangle-Barbs 'must be thrown blind through minions', implying minions blunt it. Inherent Glamour's CC-break is never mentioned.
audit.why: Blooming Burst is 800 range and Tangle-Barbs is 1000 — she is a ranged mage, not melee-dependent. Shapesplitter grants bonus damage and a move-speed burst on every third attack, which is a chase tool against a running Singed, and Pop Blossom carries the dash flag. Tangle-Barbs explicitly 'becomes larger, faster, and roots for longer' after passing through a champion or killing a unit, so a wave makes it stronger, not blinder. And Inherent Glamour breaks on receiving immobilizing crowd control — the Mega Adhesive root does that outright.
audit.corrected: She out-ranges you 800 and 1000 to Fling's 125, so break line instead of running straight — Tangle-Barbs grows through your own wave. Shapesplitter's every-third-attack move speed is her only chase and it does not catch you. Fling her into Mega Adhesive: the root is immobilizing CC, and that strips Inherent Glamour's disguise on the spot.

edits.before: Neeko wants to spam Blooming Burst Q at you from range and bait a Fling with her W clone — never commit the E to a decoy. Early levels you actually have the edge: Neeko is melee-range dependent for real damage, and you can run past her to stack Poison Trail without giving her a clean Tangle-Barbs angle. Set the lane up by hugging the poison cloud near the wave; if she steps forward to CS she eats ticks, if she hangs back she gives you the run pattern for free. The only real danger is a surprise Tangle-Barbs root into full Q burst — keep moving so her root has to be a skillshot through your moving body, not a stationary target.

notes: Neeko's Pop Blossom carries the 'dash' flag and Shapesplitter grants a move-speed burst every third attack, so the repeated 'Neeko has no dash or chase tool' framing was wrong and 'melee-range dependent for real damage' was wrong against an 800/1000-range kit. The highest-value omission was Inherent Glamour: Riot's text says the disguise breaks on receiving immobilizing crowd control, so the Mega Adhesive root strips it. DELIBERATELY NOT ASSERTED: whether Fling's knockup interrupts Pop Blossom's preparation. Riot calls it a 'short preparation', not a channel, champ-data/_kits/_missing/singed.json lists no channel-interruptible rule for Neeko, and guessing either way changes whether a player commits Fling into a fed ult.
